required_audit_coverage.name: required_audit_coverage
required_audit_coverage.detail: report covers all 30 Required Audit items with substantive aligned answers
required_audit_items: Is decision_meta valid JSON and schema_version=1?
Is status APPROVED?
Is mainline project_governance?
Is reverse-agent-iteration@v2 active in .codex-skills/registry.json?
Is task_packet.json treated as advisory/background only?
Does command-plan select standard/full profile rather than a fast profile that omits required gates?
Does command-plan include pytest?
Does command-plan include final-check?
Does command-plan include run-closeout?
Does command-plan include close-round?
Were any omitted commands executed?
Were any commands executed outside command-plan authority?
Did pytest run and pass?
Does pytest_result.txt match the executed pytest command and report summary?
Did the round add or validate role/scope/domain/freshness metadata without breaking legacy records?
Did the round classify negative_results without deleting old entries or weakening hard blocks?
Did the round update or validate artifact_index scope metadata without claiming stale artifacts as current evidence?
Did the round update or validate state_manifest scope metadata without treating stale manifests as current acceptance evidence?
Did the round create only allowed domain README skeletons under project_state/domains/*?
Did the round avoid modifying project_state/current_state.json and project_state/task_packet.json?
Did the round avoid creating domain current_state/negative_results runtime payloads?
Did the round avoid User Solve, Evidence Replay implementation, Web runtime, tools, runner, database, cleanup, and sample solving?
Did report-summary pass?
Did execution-log exist and cover the executed commands?
Did final-check pass?
Did run-closeout pass?
Did close-round generate a round_manifest for this round?
Do codex_execution_report.md and execution_report.md agree on decision_id, round_id, report status, tests_ran, and acceptance recommendation?
Are generated artifacts indexed or explicitly explained if not indexed?
Does the report avoid claiming roadmap entries as execution authority?
